clauses.clause: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and untap it.
clauses.evidence: Trace: [stimulus: turns pass ...] and [on the opponent's turn ...]: the trigger fires at YOUR end step and, with no death that turn, does nothing; the death stimuli never reach an end step, so the condition-true case is not on the board. Tree = compiler template B2a-sabertooth-mauler. Packs: sabertooth_mauler_opponent_token_died.json (the opponent's creature token dies on your turn -> +1/+1 counter, 4/4, untapped) PASS; sabertooth_mauler_death_on_opponents_turn.json (a creature dies on the opponent's turn -> no counter at their end step nor at your next end step) PASS. Existing tools/scenarios/sabertooth_mauler_end_step_death.json / _no_death_control.json cover your own creature dying and the no-death control.
